posts.zh:
dsh-pet 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。跟随 agent 状态的 DSH 原生桌宠，兼容 Codex 桌宠包，并可在插件内直接从 Petdex 导入已审核桌宠，无需 Petdex CLI。

posts.en:
dsh-pet is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Native desktop pet for DSH that follows agent activity, supports Codex pet packages, and imports approved pets directly from Petdex without its CLI.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b9846236c203672ef27d.html
